settings.heading: One journal, one story, every month.
settings.subheading: A blank journal wrapped in original animal cover art, a matching sticker sheet, and a donation to that month's charity — delivered to your door.

settings.title: How it works
settings.content: Subscribe by the 20th of the month to get that month's box. Your card is charged when your box ships, not held before. Skip, pause or cancel any time from your account — no calls, no guilt.

settings.title: What you get
settings.content: A 64-page blank journal wrapped in that month's original animal cover art, a matching hand-illustrated sticker sheet, a short story card about the animal and its charity, and a donation of 10% of your subscription to that month's cause.

settings.title: FAQs
settings.content: When does it ship? First week of the month. Can I gift it? Yes — choose a gift subscription at checkout. Can I skip a month? Any time, from your account.
